_doc: M9 Powers and disasters. Faith buildings (group services, shape church: a nave with a bell tower), the eight ruler powers and the world disasters. faith on a kind = { rate: faith per content person per minute, reach: metres, cap: how much it adds to the faith cap }. A person counts once, for the best church that reaches them. Each power lists small / medium / large in that order: cost (faith; there are no cooldowns since play-test 2), r (radius in cells), secs (how long it lasts), power (how hard it hits). Read by js/sim/powers.js and js/features/powers.js.

rain.name: Call Rain
rain.about: Clouds gather and rain falls for a while. Puts out fires and soaks the ground so it will not catch.

lightning.name: Lightning Strike
lightning.about: Bolts from the sky. Sets the spot alight and the lightning jumps between enemies near it.

frost.name: Frost Nova
frost.about: A ring of bitter cold. Freezes water, puts out fire, hardens lava and freezes enemies in place.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.about: A burning rock falls from the sky. A huge blast, a crater, debris everywhere and a pool of lava.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.about: A twister that wanders where the wind takes it, tearing up anything light and flinging the pieces.

blackhole.name: Black Hole
blackhole.about: A tear that drags everything nearby into itself for a few seconds, then collapses with a bang.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.about: The ground shakes and splits open. Tall towers and trees crack and fall.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.about: Fire falls from the sky over an area. Each burning stone sets things alight and some leave lava.

disasters._doc: World disasters on their own. perDay = how many to expect in a day (10 minutes at 1x) at each setting; graceDays = none before this; weights pick which kind; near = they land this far (min..max cells) from a random town. No lightning or forest fires on their own (play-test 2: owner did not like fires starting at random).

tornado.say: A tornado is touching down near {town}!
